name: Workshop
author: Brandon
description:
The Workshop — a separate map you step into to process materials, then carry the results back out.

This is an early build (M1): it adds an ENTER WORKSHOP button to the main menu that loads the Workshop map, so you can walk around inside it. The portal from inside your world, the material hand-off, and the throughput metering come next.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the Workshop off without unsubscribing. Hides the Enter Workshop button.
